entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago and it's just not working for me. I want my money back.
I understand. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
It's [customer email address]. Hurry, I don't have all day!

Thank you. Let me pull that up for you... Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on October 26th. Today is November 10th. Our standard return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days. Unfortunately, it looks like you are a few days outside of that return period.
What? That's ridiculous! Ten days? I didn't see anything about that. I want to return it! This thing is useless to me.

I understand your frustration. The return policy is outlined in our terms and conditions and also displayed at checkout. While I can't offer a full refund at this point, let me explore if there is a policy exception I can make.
A policy exception? What does that even mean? Just give me my money back!

I am checking to see what options are available, please bear with me. Okay, while I can't authorize a full refund since it's outside the return window, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase amount. This store credit can be used on anything on our site, and has no expiry. How does that sound?
Store credit? So I can get something else, even though I really just wanted the cash back...

Yes, exactly. You can browse our other VeloBands or perhaps some of our apparel, nutrition products, or accessories. The store credit is equivalent to the amount you paid for the VeloBand Pulse initially.
Hmm... alright. Fine. Store credit is better than nothing, I guess. How do I get the store credit?

Great! I've already applied the store credit to your account associated with [customer email address]. You should see it reflected on your account within the next hour when you log in on our website. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks. Sorry for being a bit of a pain. Appreciate you looking into the policy exception and giving me the credit.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day, and thanks for choosing VeloFit!
